results.caption:
Out of the box Claude can talk about a website but it can’t open one. These five change what it can physically do.
 
Playwright hands it a real browser, so it fills in the form, clicks through the page, and uses any site that never built a proper way in. Blotato connects it to your social accounts, so it posts for you, chops one video into a week of content, and builds the graphic itself.
 
Perplexity gives it live research, so instead of guessing from memory it reads the internet right now and shows you where every claim came from. Higgsfield opens the best video and image models up inside the chat. And Firecrawl reads any website end to end and pulls it back as clean text.
 
Ten minutes and it stops being a chatbot.
 
Comment SOCKET and I’ll send you the setup for all five.
 
#claudeai #mcp #aitools #claudecode #aiautomation
